product_overview: A portfolio website showcasing a studio’s work, services, and background, with a dedicated contact form for inquiry submissions. It also includes a Sanity Studio dashboard for content management.
core_goals: Browse the portfolio homepage and learn about the studio’s offerings
Explore detailed About, Projects, Case Study, and Contact pages
Review featured work and open external project websites
Submit an inquiry through the contact form
Access the embedded Sanity Studio for content editing

features.name: Hero Section and Preloader
features.description: An animated homepage hero that introduces the studio with rotating brand words, a preloader, and a cinematic headline reveal.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Watch preloader counter animate from 0 to 100 -> See words rotate through Studios, Films, Stories, Visions, Futures, Concepts -> Observe the hero reveal and metallic foil headline

features.name: About Section & Calls to Action
features.description: A profile and credentials section that introduces the studio and provides quick navigation to contact and work sections.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View profile copy and credentials -> Activate the contact call to action -> See the page scroll to the contact section
Navigate to / -> View profile copy and credentials -> Activate the work call to action -> See the page scroll to the projects section

features.name: Interactive Services Accordion
features.description: An expandable services area where users can inspect individual service offerings and preview imagery.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Hover over or activate a service item -> See the service expand to reveal details, title, tagline, and preview imagery

features.name: Work & Projects Showcase
features.description: A featured projects section presenting client work, descriptions, mockups, and links to live websites.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View a featured project title, client tag, description, and UI mockup -> Open the external live website link -> Return to the portfolio to continue browsing
Navigate to / -> View a featured project title, client tag, description, and UI mockup -> Activate the contact call to action -> See the page scroll to the contact section

features.name: Contact Inquiry Form
features.description: A lead capture form that lets visitors submit their name, email, and message with validation feedback and success confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in the name field -> Fill in the email address field -> Enter a message -> Submit the form -> See an instant confirmation message upon success
Navigate to /contact -> Leave required fields blank or enter an invalid email address -> Submit the form -> See inline validation feedback
Navigate to /contact -> Fill in the form fields -> Submit the form -> See a confirmation message -> Choose to send another inquiry -> See the form reset for a new submission

features.name: Dedicated About Page
features.description: A standalone page for learning more about the studio beyond the homepage summary.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> View the dedicated about content and studio background

features.name: Dedicated Case Study Page
features.description: A standalone showcase page for viewing project case study content.
user_flows: Navigate to /case-study -> View the case study showcase content

features.name: Sanity Studio Dashboard
features.description: An embedded CMS dashboard for managing site content through the Sanity Studio interface.
user_flows: Navigate to /studio -> View the embedded Sanity Studio dashboard
